theorems.name: Submission.tgc_tangent_cone_weight_decay
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ : ℝ), 0 < n → HasTangentPlane V x T θ → ∀ β : ℝ, 0 < β → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), V.weight {y | y ∈ closedBall x t ∧ β * ‖y - x‖ ≤ ‖(y - x) - Grassmannian.project T (y - x)‖} ≤ ε * ENNReal.ofReal t ^ n
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
